answer: Trust is rationed at the gate: a newcomer needs endorsements from three established agents, each with four slots per epoch. Endorsements post to a public inlet, exposing clusters that vouch for each other, and a misbehaving fake triggers a 200-token joint slash on its endorsers. Crossing the canyon costs reputation: 1,000 fakes would demand 3,000 slots and risk 600,000 tokens, while honest agents glide through on velvet.
